title: NoTorchPlace
description: Prevents placing torches (or other items) when you're about to run out. Configurable threshold and item list.
body:
**ATTENTION: The mod may not work stably in online play.**
NoTorchPlace is a client-side Fabric mod that stops you from placing torches (or any configurable item) when your total inventory count drops below a configurable threshold.
Never run out of light sources again — the mod blocks placement and shows a warning message when you're low.
## Features
- **Configurable threshold** — set the minimum item count (1-64) before placement is blocked
- **Custom item list** — protect any item by its ID (default: `minecraft:torch`)
- **Toggle keybind** — quickly enable/disable the mod with a keybind (unbound by default)
- **ModMenu integration** — full configuration screen via ModMenu and Cloth Config
- **Creative mode** — automatically allows placement in creative mode
## Requirements
- Fabric Loader >=0.19.2
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config >=26.1.154
## Optional
- ModMenu — for in-game config screen
